name: OminiFlow for WooCommerce
author: Ominiflow

sections.description:
OminiFlow for WooCommerce connects your store to Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp from a single workspace. Install the Meta pixel, sync your product catalog, run ads, and keep customers updated on WhatsApp.

With this plugin you can:

  • Connect WooCommerce to Meta platforms through your OminiFlow workspace.
  • Install the Facebook pixel and send events with Conversions API for better ad performance.
  • Sync your product catalog so shoppers can discover your products on Facebook and Instagram.
  • Reach returning visitors with relevant ads for products they viewed on your store.
  • Send WhatsApp order updates so customers stay informed without extra manual work.

OminiFlow is a commerce workspace for WooCommerce. It is not the official Meta plugin.

Support

If you need help, contact OminiFlow:

  • Website: https://ominiflow.com/
  • Email: info@ominiflow.com

When reporting an issue, please include:

  • What you expected vs what happened
  • A screenshot, if possible
  • Your website URL
  • Current versions of OminiFlow for WooCommerce, WooCommerce, WordPress, and PHP

Known limitations

Crash recovery uses a shutdown handler to write a disable flag and queue a sanitized crash report.
In rare PHP memory-exhaustion fatals, there may be too little memory left for the shutdown handler to run.
When that happens, the site still recovers on the next request, but the disable flag and crash report may be skipped for that request.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install OminiFlow for WooCommerce from Plugins → Add New, or upload the plugin zip.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to OminiFlow in your WordPress admin and create or sign in to your OminiFlow account.
  5. Complete the Meta and WhatsApp connection from your OminiFlow workspace.

For more help, visit ominiflow.com.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. This plugin requires WooCommerce and will not run without it.

Do I need an OminiFlow account?

Yes. Sign up or log in from the plugin onboarding screen, then connect Meta and WhatsApp from your OminiFlow workspace.

Is this the official Meta for WooCommerce plugin?

No. OminiFlow for WooCommerce is published by OminiFlow. It helps you connect WooCommerce to Meta platforms through the OminiFlow workspace.
sections.changelog:
3.7.5 – 2026-07-14

  • Initial WordPress.org release of OminiFlow for WooCommerce.
  • Connect WooCommerce to Meta platforms (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp) from the OminiFlow workspace.
  • Catalog sync, Meta pixel, Conversions API, and WhatsApp order updates.
  • OminiFlow account signup/login and credential sync from the WordPress admin.
  • Crash recovery so a plugin fatal can disable itself safely and recover on the next request.
